title: RosmarOps — findings memory v4
description: findings-memory.json in the reports directory (decision memoria, M2): each v2 finding's verdict history, by salted reference only. v2 (decision 2026-10-26, agentes y MCP nuevos, A2) adds salt_ref and last_checked.agent_refs. v3 (BV-91, D3) adds last_checked.mcp_dest_refs. v4 (BV-273) adds last_checked.repos_complete, entries[].repos and the verdict resolved. Never paths, services, fingerprints, host_id, values or text.

salt_ref.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the local salt with a fixed label (not host_id's), 16 hex: a different salt makes the run salt_changed.

agent_refs.description: Salted references of the agents seen in this run, by their comparison key (A1): a client or an extension by its node id, an MCP server by client, name and scope. Never names or paths. Absent when the base was carried over from a v1 memory: no base for new agents.

mcp_dest_refs.description: Salted references of each MCP server's destination (BV-91, D3): HMAC(salt, comparison key ‖ destination_ref)[:16]. Never a destination in clear. Absent when the base was carried over from a v1 or v2 memory: no base for a change of destination.

repos_complete.description: Salted references of the repositories whose check finished in this run (BV-273): HMAC(local_salt, normalized absolute path)[:16], only for a repository that did not time out, inside the global limit, and whose root the project search finished. Never a path. Absent when the base was carried over from a v1, v2 or v3 memory: no repository finding is resolved against it.

oneOf.description: The last run with complete coverage: the base of the next comparison.

mid.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the finding id with the local salt, 16 hex.

last_report.description: Base name of a report file: date, colour and counts only.

agent.description: Salted reference of the finding's agent.

creds.description: Salted references of the finding's credentials, for moved or merged.

repos.description: Salted references of the repositories the finding is in (BV-273), as last_checked.repos_complete: empty for a finding outside every repository. Absent on an entry carried over from a v3 memory and not seen since: its place is not known, so it is never resolved.
